body:
Fossa CR 2

This long-bodied creature looks vaguely like a cat but on second glance looks very different.

XP 600
N Small animal
Init +6; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+5 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)
hp 11 (2d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +9, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft
Melee bite +6 (1d4+1 plus trip), 2 claws +6 (1d2+1)
Special Attacks pounce, rake (2 claws +6, 1d2+1)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 16, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 6
Base Attack +1; CMB +1; CMD 16 (20 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +10, Climb +9, Perception +5, Stealth +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics

ECOLOGY

Environment forests
Organization solitary or cooperative (3 or more)
Treasure none

Fossas are a rare creature easily confused with small cougars. While very different, they are a closer relative to mongooses. Diverging from mongooses, they developed felid features. They are adept climbers and carnivorous creatures, hunting prey by pouncing from above in the trees. Typically small, larger fossa, nearly the size of humans have been spotted in remote forests.
